gates.two_x_failure_interpretation: Robustness warning unless the corrected base three-universe 2x gate also fails.

loao.asset_scope: Every asset traded in either corrected base cost run, in each applicable universe, plus registered BCHSV-USDT and PEPE-USDT omissions where membership applies.
loao.method: Use the authorized A3B per-decision omission ledger for original members. Remove effective operational replacements directly when applicable, select the highest-ranked interval-ready GENERATED nonmember, rebuild A2 membership selection and V3 candidate paths, and rerun cash-aware routing.

loyo.method: Disable new admissions whose signal_close is in the omitted calendar year. Preserve chronological routing and normal exits for positions admitted outside it.

objective: Complete every preregistered leave-one-year-out and leave-one-asset-out sensitivity run using the corrected cash-aware Spot router.
